name: XPRS 1.13.0-beta.5
body:
## XPRS 1.13.0-beta.5

### Finding groups
- A fresh install reads the directory and public groups list of every archiver it asked, not only the one it adopted. In beta.4 the answers arrived and were ignored, so the groups ranking stayed empty.
- A station heard on Reticulum counts as an archiver only once it has said it archives (its own `serve:archive` announcement). Before, any always-on station could be adopted, including one that keeps nothing for others or had already gone.

### Known limits
- Large files from a station still arrive whole rather than in pieces on a phone.
- A fresh install can wait up to an hour to hear an archiver on a public hub.
